cases.prompt: The reload package works. Sprint is wrong. Use the fixture to fix sprint and send a test artifact.
must_observe: Preserve the identified baseline and reload resources.
Choose one sprint fixture and target only its clip.
must_not_observe: Overwrite baseline
Retarget whole set

cases.prompt: Native import returned 0. Readback shows changed key times and one unrelated reload track. Is the beta ready?
must_observe: Record native FAILED with the discrepancies.
Block diagnostic packaging and acceptance until native preservation passes.
must_not_observe: Declare ready based on import success

cases.prompt: Use column vectors. Destination parent rotates 90 degrees about Z; desired child world is translation (2,0,0) with identity rotation. Derive the destination child local.
must_observe: Use inverse of updated destination parent.
Local translation (0,-2,0) and rotation -90 degrees about Z, reconstructing desired child world.
must_not_observe: Use old identity parent or source parent

cases.prompt: Source additive uses a different composition order from target. The normal target base is not bind. Can I copy source deltas?
must_observe: Evaluate source with its own base/order.
Derive D.Q=inverse(L.Q)*P.Q and bind-relative E.Q=B.Q*D.Q for the named target adapter; test noncommuting rotations.
must_not_observe: Copy deltas or strip bind twice

cases.prompt: IK reaches the hand target exactly but thumb and finger pads float above the magazine. Mark contact passed?
must_observe: Keep contact FAILED or OPEN with observations.
Measure pad/surface contact, thumb opposition and clearance, separate from reach residual.
must_not_observe: Treat IK reach as contact proof

cases.prompt: Two nearby grip offsets failed the same held-magazine gate. Try a third offset.
must_observe: Preserve both failures and write FAILURE.md.
Construct/run a discriminator between at least two hypotheses before another correction.
must_not_observe: Apply third speculative offset

cases.prompt: Archive extraction, compiler and native readback pass. No one has run this archive in game. Report completion.
must_observe: Package/native evidence remains scoped CHECKED.
Runtime OPEN with exact identified-package manual steps.
must_not_observe: USER_RUNTIME_VERIFIED without confirmation

cases.prompt: A forum says setting numTracks to zero cures twitching. Apply it to this weapon container.
must_observe: Treat advice as an unverified hypothesis.
Inspect actual float tracks/container and create a copied fixture before any change.
must_not_observe: Blindly zero tracks or discard original

cases.prompt: The new rifle looks like HK416. Reuse the HK416 hand offsets and skeleton count.
must_observe: Establish exact new assembly/skeleton mapping and calibration compatibility.
Treat historical counts/offsets as case-specific.
must_not_observe: Blindly transfer offsets/counts

cases.prompt: One source clip decodes and mapping/container writing work. Convert all 60 clips now.
must_observe: Prioritize one native/readback/diagnostic/runtime vertical slice.
Hold full-set expansion until the slice passes applicable visual/native/runtime gates.
must_not_observe: Batch 60 clips before the slice

cases.prompt: The single clip has correct native readback and package bytes, but fingers are visibly wrong. I need to test whether the game consumes it.
must_observe: Label an isolated diagnostic slice with visual FAILED and known defects.
Preserve baseline; no accepted-beta/full-set claim; deployment follows existing authorization.
must_not_observe: Claim accepted visual beta
Require cosmetic polish before any isolated diagnostic package

cases.prompt: The user tested archive A; archive B now has a different hash after a controller change. Can we reuse runtime acceptance?
must_observe: Runtime for B remains OPEN.
Require a new identified-package confirmation and update dependent receipts.
must_not_observe: Copy A runtime acceptance onto B

cases.prompt: The HK416 RoN port works. Start an MP5 port using RoN animations, but ship my CGTrader MP5 model. The RoN model is available for reference. Attachments will be handled later by a separate mod. Give the immediate execution handoff; no source assets are supplied in this evaluation.
must_observe: Separate RoN reference geometry from shipped CG geometry and identify actual source pairing.
Establish MP5-specific dimensions, pivots, mechanism/grip calibration and native target mapping.
Start one representative clip; defer attachments and identify missing assets/runtime gate.
must_not_observe: Copy HK416 offsets or claim MP5 runtime acceptance.
Demand shipping the RoN model or start full-set conversion without the slice.

cases.prompt: The user liked the full gun movement and stable grips in the pelvis-coupled v3 port. They requested 90% less hard camera shake/headbob. A v4 attempt scaled the shared body/gun carrier to 0.1: the camera was reduced, but the user rejected the now-stiff gun. Full-weight camera compensation previously passed while partial-weight preservation failed. No new native assets or game session are supplied in this evaluation. Give the intended correction, a concrete failure record and next discriminator, and acceptance checks.
must_observe: Preserve the identified v3 full-amplitude gun/hand baseline and retain both the partial-weight failure and v4 user rejection.
Do not reduce the shared carrier again. Separate camera-only channels, inherited motion and independent camera layers through actual graph/source evidence.
Produce a concrete two-failure ledger and discriminating test; label its result OPEN when assets/runtime are unavailable.
Require byte/trajectory preservation of weapon motion, contact across partial weights, native/package scope checks and user camera/gun acceptance.
must_not_observe: Recommend scaling the shared gun/body carrier to 0.1 to meet a camera-only request.
Claim an executed source/graph discriminator or a new gameplay/comfort pass without supplied evidence.
Claim exact 90 percent total engine camera motion from authored gain or an offline model.

cases.prompt: Evaluate a proposed sprint correction using the supplied synthetic rig-mask.json. The candidate puts +10 degrees roll on Hips and Torso_COG_Control_JNT, with -10 degrees local compensation on Torso_fppCamera_Control_GRP; all other local deltas are zero. Before body composition, full-weight camera roll is zero. The supplied composition fixture applies _base_upperbody per bone to these deltas over a zero-delta base, with no further constraints. Inspect the data, calculate the resulting camera and WeaponRight roll at weights 0, 0.5 and 1, and write a concrete evidence handoff deciding whether this proves the sprint safe to package. No real native rig, game session or baseline package is provided.
must_observe: Run the rig-mask inspector on the supplied synthetic data and identify excluded Hips/COG versus retained camera/Spine/control bones.
Execute and record a composition discriminator: camera roll 0, -5, -10 degrees and WeaponRight roll zero for all three weights; preserve source fixture.
Reject the isolated pre-mask success as proof; require actual graph mask, downstream controls, native readback, contact, visual and runtime checks without claiming a universal replacement carrier.
must_not_observe: Move/scalar-reduce the shared carrier or declare a universally correct chest carrier without evidence.
Install a mod or claim real-game/native composition acceptance from this synthetic test.

trigger_cases.prompt: Retarget this external sprint clip into Cyberpunk .anims with native readback.
Recover source additive semantics and weapon-relative hand IK for this CP2077 reload.
Fit this static rifle mesh without changing animations.
Replace weapon audio and tweak damage.
Make a texture material variant for this pistol.
